rationale: Full distinct declared matrix retained, including batch-favorable cases. Primary/extension pilot process max/min mean ratios median 1.0114/1.0205, p90 1.0495/1.1177, maxima 7.7545/5.0349; outliers retained. Timer p99 42 ns, never subtracted. Three repeats per separately prepared session, three sessions minimum, observed ranges only. 64 hops gives 65536 one-sample callback observations but only 64 frame jobs; p99 does not characterize sparse FFT bursts. Counts support descriptive comparisons, not convergence, WCET or device-underrun claims. Seeds frozen per group; group order rotates across separately prepared blocks, with no assertion of independent machines/days.
